investigated_schedulers.name: FIFO
investigated_schedulers.notes: Ignores task duration variance. Long architectural reasoning tasks block short coding tasks.

investigated_schedulers.name: Shortest-Job-First
investigated_schedulers.notes: Starves long-running reasoning tasks. Bad for mixed workload.

investigated_schedulers.name: Model-aware scheduling
investigated_schedulers.notes: Tasks routed to appropriate model based on task type. ornith-9b for reasoning, qwen7b for coding, qwen3b for secondary.

investigated_schedulers.name: Dependency-aware scheduling
investigated_schedulers.notes: Tasks execute only after dependencies complete. Build waits for generation; verification waits for build.

investigated_schedulers.name: Capacity-aware scheduling
investigated_schedulers.notes: M1 gets architectural reasoning + primary coding. HP gets secondary coding. Prevents M1 overload.

investigated_schedulers.name: Hybrid (current)
investigated_schedulers.notes: Model-aware + dependency-aware + capacity-aware. This is the current scheduler in run_18h_opt.py.

current_scheduler.description: Tasks are classified by type, routed to appropriate model/machine, and executed only when dependencies are met. M1 handles reasoning + primary coding. HP handles secondary coding. Build and inference overlap via OPT-1.
current_scheduler.critical_path_awareness: Scheduler understands that inference is the long pole and preloads models (OPT-2) + keeps them alive (OPT-3) to minimize inference stall.

comparison.FIFO_wall_est: Higher - no model awareness, cold TTFT penalties
comparison.Model-aware_only: Better TTFT but serialization if dependencies ignored
